notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
[b]Happy Tuesday, everyone![/b] 😊 

  

We are finalizing the latest update for [i]Last Shot[/i] now, but I wanted to go ahead and share the notes! ✨ 

  

[list] 

[*] Updated to allow full controller support 

[*] Updated audio to support Dolby Surround 

[*] Updated graphical fidelity to improve picture quality 

[*] Updated soundtrack to include all 60 tracks for in-game and main menu 

[*] Updated gameplay mechanics to provide a better playing experience 

[*] Updated health mechanics to allow for regeneration of health when out of combat 

[*] Updated game timers to provide a fast experience 

[*] Updated main menu 

[*] Updated the ability to leave game rather than exit to allow players to leave current game and return to main menu 

[*] Reduced haptic feedback so it’s not overwhelming 

[*] Updated lighting 

[*] Updated visual fx 

[*] Updated maps and layouts of maps 

[*] Updated game balance 

[*] Updated and adjusted map boundaries 

[*] Adjusted splash damage 

[*] Updated melee damage 

[*] Updated user interface 

[*] Updated double jump to not pop off instantly when using controller 

[*] Updated controller vibrations for firing weapons 

[*] Updated game to be nVidia DLSS aware (still working on full integration) 

[*] Updated all visuals to HDR 

[*] Updated visual quality to support 4K 

[*] Adjusted color palette to give better color visuals 

[*] Updated to allow for multiple resolution scales 

[*] Updated Campaign tab to give brief description of what to expect with the story mode 

[*] Multiplayer maps will be manually rotated weekly during server maintenance 

[*] Added ability to explore multiplayer maps through Campaign tab until story mode launches 

[*] Updated logos and branding 

[*] Updated minor physics changes 

[*] Added controls image in Options menu 

[*] Added invert ability to both X Axis and Y Axis 

[*] Updated and fixed game auto starting with Y Axis inverted 

[*] Updated and changed camera system on main menu 

[*] Added new characters to main menu 

[*] Updated weapon audio 

[/list] 

  

Known Issues 

[list] 

[*] Some maps may cause servers to crash, we are looking into what causes this issue 

[*] Controls are not mapped to correct buttons will be updated soon

[*] Health regen is still being worked on and will be updated soon 

[/list] 

  

On behalf of our devs, I want to thank you again for your support for everything we are doing including [i]Last Shot[/i]. We would not be where we are without you! 

  

Also, if you have not done so already, be [b]sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/87uug8WNnj]Discord[/url] server and let us know what you think of the update[/b]!
